fields.quoted_span: A notice to quit for nonpayment of rent given in writing by a landlord to a residential tenant pursuant to this chapter shall be accompanied by a form that shall include, but not be limited to:
fields.note: All elements of the requirement (form contents, prominent statement, EOHLC development, languages, court filing bar) match the text. The statute says "residential assistance for families in transition program"; the rule's use of the acronym RAFT is a harmless gloss.

fields.quoted_span: The information in clause (ii) of subsection (a) shall be made available in the 5 most common languages spoken in the commonwealth in addition to English.
fields.note: The form is required with every nonpayment notice to quit, and the court filing bar rests on proof of delivery. The language requirement covers only the clause (ii) information.
The rule leaves effective_date empty and the document states no effective date.

fields.quoted_span: Section 31. (a) A notice to quit for nonpayment of rent given in writing by a landlord to a residential tenant pursuant to this chapter shall be accompanied by a form
fields.note: The document is current statutory text with no repeal or sunset, which is consistent with in_force. It states no explicit status, so this is inferred.

fields.quoted_span: in an eviction for nonpayment of rent for a residential dwelling unit
fields.note: Coverage is limited to residential tenants and dwelling units, and the text contains no unit-count, age or owner exemptions.
